freshnessClaims.heading: Fresh is our #1 Goal
freshnessClaims.source: Printed on page 2 of the menu — real restaurant copy, usable on the About page.
claims: Our flour tortillas are made from scratch directly from our tortilla machine & baked as soon as you order
Our vegetables are selected fresh every day
Our chicken and steak are marinated with only natural ingredients and are grilled to order
We use high quality steak for all steak orders
We do not use any oil in preparing our sauce, rice & beans
